title: Runway
summary: New York generative-video company supplying production tools to film, advertising and design teams.
bodyHtml:
Runway develops video-generation and editing models, including the Gen series, and sells them through a browser-based studio with team workflows.

The company has partnerships with media companies and studios, and its tools are used for previsualisation, VFX and advertising rather than only short social clips.

Why it matters

  • Text and image to video
  • Editing and motion controls
  • Enterprise media workflows

businessMeaning: Video generation is compute-hungry and the quality bar is set by professional production. Pricing power depends on fitting into editing workflows, not on demos.
investmentLens: Private; exposure runs through cloud compute and media companies that adopt the tools.
